checks.explanation: Spencer Pratt finished third in the June 2, 2026 LA mayoral primary with 25.8% of the vote, well short of the outright 51% majority he predicted; incumbent Karen Bass (34.3%) and Nithya Raman (28.6%) advanced to the runoff instead.

sources.title: Spencer Pratt Fails To Progress In Los Angeles Mayor's Race

checks.explanation: No source found confirms that Bel Air, Mandeville Canyon, Sunland-Tujunga, or the Hollywood Hills have burned in a wildfire since this prediction was made.
Moot: Pratt lost the mayoral race and never took office, so this conditional 'if elected' claim was never tested.
